description: Convert a document (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT) or an image into clean Markdown for an LLM, with tables extracted as rows and OCR (French, English) for scanned PDFs and images. Give a public URL or a local file path (max 10 MB). 0.005 USDC per call, only if text is found. Nothing stored.

file_path.description: Local file path (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT), sent as the request body instead of url

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the document

name: doc_to_markdown
